panels.description: Computed on the server. A problem is a check down (three failed probes in a row: no answer, a 503 or another error) or degraded (a 2xx whose body says the database is down), a firing alert (amber for a held staff account, red for a frozen one and every other), auth not ready, a worker stale or erroring, a drain tick that raised or a tenant not ok. Each side (Prometheus: checks and alerts; Loki: logs) is gated on its own count, so one going blind never hides the other's problems. Up to three on a side show a line each; above three, one roll-up line for that side with the earliest start and the count, red when any is red and amber when all are amber, naming TPA first whenever it has a failing check. The watchtower's own blindness (a scrape target down, no checks loaded, no tpa log lines in 5 minutes, Loki's rules stopped, no lines reaching Loki in a minute) is always its own '? Watchtower blind' line. 'All running systems normal' appears only when both sides answer and every count is zero; otherwise, with no line to show, this reads '? Can't tell'.
